title: BreakdownTasksOutput
description: Output of the breakdown-tasks skill: a list of atomic delegation packets that together fulfill a user request.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the overall user request, capturing its goal, scope, and constraints. This gives downstream workers context without requiring them to re-read the full prompt.

tasks.description: An ordered, uncapped list of atomic delegation packets. Create as many tasks as the independent work requires; each task must represent one unit of work that can be completed and verified independently.

taskId.description: Stable optional identity for this task. Legacy packets may omit it; validators use the ordered task position as a migration identity.

purpose.description: Single sentence describing what this task accomplishes. Must be actionable and self-contained.

context.description: Task-specific context for the worker. Include the relevant user-request details, background information, and constraints. Do not add filler text. Supports longer prompts up to 8000 characters.

filesToRead.description: Explicit list of file paths the worker must read before starting. Purposeful task-related discovery remains permitted under the worker contract.

filesToWrite.description: Explicit write boundary containing file paths or bounded path patterns the worker is authorized to create, modify, or delete.

skills.description: One to three skills the worker must load before executing. Each entry must match an available skill name exactly.

executionInstructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for the worker. Each step is a discrete, verifiable action. Steps must be ordered and numbered.

action.description: What to do in this step. Must be concrete and verifiable.

verification.description: Optional: how to verify this step succeeded (e.g., 'File exists at path X', 'Tests pass', 'No error output').
Top-level verification checks the worker must run against their output before finishing. These are checks on the complete deliverable, not per-step checks.

expectedOutput.description: Precise description of the Deliverable payload this task produces. Use concrete language such as file paths, function names, and data formats.

verificationCoverage.description: Optional publication metadata describing observable checks for this task. Omission is migration-compatible and is diagnosed as a warning.

couplingRationale.description: Optional inspectable exception for multiple files that publish one tightly coupled result.

dependencies.description: Optional directed dependency edges. References use taskId when present, or the migration identity task-<one-based-position>.

antiPatternSignals.description: Optional documented signals considered during authoring; signals are not proof of conceptual independence.

purposeOutputAlignment.description: Optional explicit authoring assessment connecting the purpose to the expected output.
